question: A capacitor stores a charge of $6 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$ when a potential difference of $12\text{ V}$ is applied across its plates. Calculate its capacitance. Also state what this capacitance physically represents.

options.A: $C=\frac{Q}{V}=5\times10^{-7}\,\text{F}=0.5\,\mu\text{F}$; it represents the charge stored per unit potential difference
options.B: $C=\frac{V}{Q}=2\times10^{6}\,\text{F}$; it represents energy stored per unit charge
options.C: $C=7.2\times10^{-5}\,\text{F}$; it represents potential difference per unit charge
options.D: $C=12\,\mu\text{F}$; it represents the total charge on both plates
